aboutTagline: Your windows, at hand like a deck of cards.

@badgeDesktop.description: A window's Space, in the preview's header.

@badgeDesktopShort.description: A window's Space, compact in the list.

@badgeDisplay.description: A window on an external display.

@badgeFullScreen.description: A window in full screen or Split View.

@badgeHidden.description: A window of a hidden app (Cmd-H).

@hintClear.description: The key hint of Escape while searching.

@hintMove.description: The key hint of the arrow keys.

@hintSwitch.description: The key hint of Return while searching.

@keySpace.description: The space bar, on a key cap.

@licenseActive.description: A license activated on this Mac.

licenseDeactivated: This Mac is deactivated: the key can serve another one.
licenseDeactivateDetail: Frees one of the license's three Macs.
licenseInvalid: This key is not valid, or it is active on three Macs already.
licenseNetwork: Could not reach the license server. Check the connection and try again.
licensePitch: The predicted next window, search ranked by your habits, and more to come. One purchase, three Macs.
licenseThanks: Thank you! Windeck Pro is activated.
licenseTrial: Trial · {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left
onboardShortcutDetail: Hold it and press Tab to go through your windows; let go to switch.
onboardShortcutNote: You can change it any time in Settings.
onboardWelcomeDetail: Switch to any window like a browser tab. Windeck needs two permissions; nothing ever leaves your Mac.
permAccessibilityDetail: Lists, raises, closes and minimizes windows.
permAccessibilityWhy: Needed to list your windows, switch to them, and hear the shortcut.
permScreenDetail: Shows windows' pictures in the preview.
permScreenRestart: macOS applies Screen Recording once Windeck restarts.
permScreenWhy: Shows large previews of your windows. Without it, Windeck shows titles only.
previewApp: Running, with no windows open. Switching brings it forward.
previewExcluded: On your privacy list: Windeck never captures this app.
previewHidden: This app is hidden. Switching shows it again.
previewMinimized: Minimized before Windeck saw it, so there is no picture yet. Switching brings it back.
previewNoPermission: Allow Screen Recording in Settings to see previews.
previewOff: Previews are turned off in Settings.
privacyExcludedDetail: Windeck never captures these apps' windows, never keeps their titles, and learns nothing from them.
privacyPromise: Window pictures, your habits and what Windeck learns stay on this Mac. Titles, pictures and app lists are never sent anywhere.
resetDetail: Forgets your habits, predictions and every window picture kept.
settingsPreviewsDetail: Off, the switcher shows titles alone.
settingsPrimaryDisplayDetail: Otherwise the panel shows where you work.
settingsQuickDelayDetail: Released sooner, the shortcut switches without showing the panel.
settingsWindowlessDetail: Listed at the end, to bring them forward.
shortcutCommandDetail: Takes over ⌘Tab: for heavy multi-window use and Windows habits.
shortcutOptionDetail: Keeps the system's ⌘Tab for apps; ⌥Tab goes to windows.
smartLocalNote: Learned on this Mac only, from the windows you switch to.
smartNeedsPro: Smart features are part of Windeck Pro. Activate a license to turn them on.
smartPersonalDetail: The same letters bring the window you go to most first.
smartPredictDetail: The first Tab always goes back; the second goes where you usually go next.
